title: What is Focker-in-Law about? Greg Focker meets his son's fiancée
answer: Focker-in-Law is the fourth "Meet the Parents" movie, set about 25 years after the first. Greg Focker (Ben Stiller) meets his son Henry's fiancée, Olivia (Ariana Grande), a former FBI hostage negotiator who wins over the family, including Jack Byrnes (Robert De Niro), and becomes Greg's new rival. It opens in theaters Nov. 25, 2026.
body:
The story flips the setup of 2000's Meet the Parents. This time Greg is the nervous parent: his son Henry (Skyler Gisondo) brings home Olivia Jones (Ariana Grande), a life coach and ex-FBI hostage negotiator. To Greg's dismay, everyone loves her right away, and the clash comes to a head over a weekend celebrating Jack's 80th birthday. The trailer shows Jack strapping Olivia to his old lie detector, a callback to his interrogation of Greg in the original.

Returning cast members include Robert De Niro as Jack, Ben Stiller as Greg, Teri Polo as Pam, Blythe Danner as Dina and Owen Wilson as Kevin, Pam's ex. Beanie Feldstein takes over as Greg's daughter, Samantha, and Gisondo plays the now-grown Henry; both roles were played by child actors in 2010's Little Fockers. Eduardo Franco is also in the cast.

John Hamburg, a co-writer of the earlier films, wrote and directed, with a story credit shared with Ilana Glazer and Austen Earl. Universal releases it in the U.S. and Canada and Paramount handles it internationally. It runs about 105 minutes and was shot in New York in the fall of 2025.

You do not need to rewatch the earlier movies, but it helps to know the basics: Meet the Parents (2000), Meet the Fockers (2004) and Little Fockers (2010) follow nurse Greg Focker trying to win over his suspicious father-in-law, a retired CIA officer. Focker-in-Law is the first new entry in more than 15 years.
in_the_news: Focker-in-Law, the first new Meet the Parents movie in 16 years, opens in U.S. theaters Wednesday, Nov. 25, 2026, ahead of Thanksgiving.
